title: Andres Duany Lecture. Suburban Sprawl.
summary: A recording of Andres Duany's 1991 'San Antonio By Design' seminar on suburban sprawl. He lays out how codes, zoning and policy produce sprawl and makes the case for new urbanism.
why: HN recommends it as a comprehensive, still-accurate and often funny account of how zoning and policy force suburban sprawl.

quote.text: His talk from 30 years ago is still so eerily precise and comprehensive
